summary: @servicetitan/feature-spotlight preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727 KB obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` cyclic-shift over a large hex/int constant array) and a base64-alphabet decoder — classic string-array obfuscation with `_0xNNNN` renamed identifiers. The advertised package purpose is a React UI feature-spotlight component; its actual runtime `main` (`dist/index.js`) is 168 bytes exporting three React components. The obfuscated Bun payload is reachable only through the preinstall dropper and runs automatically on `npm install`, using an alternate language runtime to evade scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. Impersonation of a ServiceTitan-scoped internal package is consistent with a dependency-confusion / scope-hijack supply-chain attack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
